cohort: Very low birth weight (VLBW) infants hospitalized in the NICU between 2005 and 2019.
finding: Human milk feeding, particularly Mother's Own Milk, was associated with a significant reduction in necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), late-onset sepsis (LOS), and the risk of severe retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) and bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) in very low birth weight infants.
